original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. Check current handoffs, including #5625 row reentry and #5707 root-prefix lowering, without treating their partial scope as the whole theorem.
